T1.notes: release-integrity helper discovers public packages, builds changelog-backed notes, creates/updates GitHub Releases, verifies npm/tag/release agreement, and supports npm-current repair reruns

T2.notes: Release workflow runs npm-current check before publish and release-integrity after tag creation with GH_TOKEN/NODE_AUTH_TOKEN

T3.notes: docs/release.md defines npm+tag+GitHub Release+latest done bar; focused tests cover helper, workflow wiring, and docs guard
